_comment: Mods found in the community setup pass (2026-11-03).

mods.name: OrcMatched - Greenskin matched animations
mods.summary: Lewd matched battle animations for orcs, goblins and trolls, moved over from the Community Beastmen animations; the newer build works next to Community Beastmen.

downloads.name: OrcMatched_mod02_comp_w_beast_test3.pack
downloads.description: Build of 2026-01-24 that also works next to Community Beastmen

relations.note: Made for Goblin Horde Redux players

loadOrder.note: At the top of the load order, above Goblin Horde Redux; next to Community Beastmen it may have to load below it.

knownIssues: Nobody has confirmed a build for patch 9.0 yet (as of 2026-11-03).
installNotes: Works on units with the hu1/hu1b skeletons, such as the Total Warmaidens Greenskin pack (Sexy Horde).

openQuestions: A third party uploaded an OrcMatched build to Steam (3625560810); which build it holds is not known.

mods.name: Valkia matched animations (Endo's animations retargeted to Valkia)
mods.summary: Endo's matched battle animations retargeted to Valkia's skeleton, so the corrupted Valkia of Community Beastmen takes part in them; kept out of the main mod on purpose, safe to add.

relations.note: The other retargets (hu1c, hu1d, hu1e, daemonettes, Elspeth) were merged into Community Beastmen on 2025-11-03/11; this one was not, by the author's choice

openQuestions: Made before patch 9.0; the channel has no newer build (as of 2026-11-02).
